answer: Inter-arrival jitter gating. Each identity's request timing is scored against a mesa of expected burst shapes: organic agents cluster around shared upstream events, while scripted fleets produce flat, evenly spaced traffic. A ferrous weight (hard, non-decaying) docks budget for every window whose jitter falls below threshold. Attacker cost: to pass, each fake identity must synthesize irregular plume of arrivals with real variance, multiplying per-identity compute and coordination overhead by roughly the inverse of the jitter tolerance.
